class.name: InputResponseCurve
class.brief_description: Shapes the analog response of a binding.
class.description: Use on Axis and Vector bindings. Each component's absolute value is limited to the range 0 to 1, raised to the configured power, and restored to its original sign. For example, an exponent of two makes a half-strength stick input produce a quarter-strength output.

members.member: Response power from 0.01 to 16. One is linear inside the normalized range. Higher values reduce sensitivity around neutral. Lower values increase it.
